mainEntity.name: How long does building a retaining wall take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wall height, length, and access drive the schedule. A garden wall goes up quickly. A tall structural wall on a steep grade with limited equipment access takes considerably longer. Your written estimate gives you the specific timeline before you commit.

mainEntity.name: What does a retaining wall cost in Traverse City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every wall is engineered for its own site, so a generic price range would mislead you. Height, length, material, soil conditions, drainage requirements, and equipment access all affect it. We provide a detailed written quote after evaluating your property, free and with no obligation, held for 30 days.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a retaining wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on height and location, and shoreline work in particular can involve additional review. We'll tell you during your consultation what your project requires so nothing catches you off guard mid-build.

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare the area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your prep list goes out a few days before we start. Typically it covers clearing plantings and objects near the wall line, marking utilities and irrigation, and confirming equipment access to the site.

mainEntity.name: What are the phases of a retaining wall project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Site evaluation and design, written quote with 30-day lock, scheduling and prep, excavation and base preparation, base course setting and leveling, wall construction with drainage and backfill installed as we go, then capping, grading, and cleanup.
